title: Table 5-2: Description for status of indicator light of rectifier (REC)
markdown:
Table 5-2: Description for status of indicator light of rectifier (REC)

| Green and on       | Rectifier is in normal working condition   |
|--------------------|--------------------------------------------|
| Green and flashing | Rectifier is in soft start condition       |
| Red and on         | Rectifier is in fault                      |
| Off                | Rectifier cannot work                      |
